_note: Schematic organelle models. Shapes are illustrative. Sizes and function text come from the catalog compartment named in `compartment`.

summary.en: Double-membrane organelle that makes most of the cell's ATP by oxidative phosphorylation.
summary.zh-Hant: 雙層膜細胞器，經氧化磷酸化製造細胞大部分 ATP。

text.en: Smooth membrane with porins, permeable to small molecules.
text.zh-Hant: 平滑嘅膜，含孔蛋白，小分子可以通過。

text.en: Narrow gap between the two membranes where protons accumulate.
text.zh-Hant: 兩層膜之間嘅窄間隙，質子喺此積聚。

text.en: Holds the respiratory complexes and ATP synthase. Complex I (PDB 5XTD) sits here.
text.zh-Hant: 載有呼吸鏈複合體同 ATP 合成酶。Complex I（PDB 5XTD）位於此處。

text.en: Folds of the inner membrane that raise its surface area.
text.zh-Hant: 內膜嘅摺疊，增加表面積。

text.en: Enzymes of the citric acid cycle and fatty acid oxidation, plus mitochondrial DNA.
text.zh-Hant: 含檸檬酸循環同脂肪酸氧化嘅酵素，以及粒線體 DNA。

text.en: Small circular genome in the matrix.
text.zh-Hant: 基質內嘅小型環狀基因組。

summary.en: Holds the chromosomes inside a double membrane studded with pores.
summary.zh-Hant: 染色體藏於佈滿核孔嘅雙層膜之內。

text.en: Two membranes with the perinuclear space between them, continuous with the rough ER.
text.zh-Hant: 兩層膜，中間係核周間隙，同粗面內質網相連。

text.en: Large protein channels that control traffic between nucleus and cytoplasm.
text.zh-Hant: 大型蛋白通道，控制細胞核同細胞質之間嘅運輸。

text.en: DNA wound on histones, filling the nuclear interior.
text.zh-Hant: DNA 纏繞組織蛋白，充滿核內。

text.en: Dense region where ribosomal RNA is made and ribosomes begin to assemble.
text.zh-Hant: 致密區域，製造核糖體 RNA，並開始組裝核糖體。

summary.en: Stacked flattened sacs coated with ribosomes. Makes secreted and membrane proteins.
summary.zh-Hant: 由扁平囊疊成，表面佈滿核糖體。合成分泌蛋白同膜蛋白。

text.en: Flattened membrane sheets enclosing the lumen.
Space inside the sheets where new proteins fold.
text.zh-Hant: 片層內部，新合成嘅蛋白質喺此摺疊。

text.en: Bound to the outer face. The 80S ribosome (PDB 4UG0) can be opened in Module B.
text.zh-Hant: 附於外表面。80S 核糖體（PDB 4UG0）可喺模組 B 開啟。

summary.en: Stack of cisternae that modifies and sorts proteins from the ER.
summary.zh-Hant: 一疊扁囊，修飾並分揀來自內質網嘅蛋白質。

text.zh-Hant: 接收來自內質網嘅囊泡。

text.en: Enzymes here trim and add sugars to proteins.
text.zh-Hant: 此處嘅酵素修剪並為蛋白質加上糖基。

text.en: Sorts finished proteins into vesicles leaving the stack.
text.zh-Hant: 將完成嘅蛋白質分揀入離開高爾基體嘅囊泡。

text.en: Small vesicles carrying cargo between compartments.
text.zh-Hant: 喺各區室之間運送貨物嘅小囊泡。
